theorems.name: Submission.mean_oscillation_lintegral_le_of_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (u : Rn n → ℝ) (O : ℕ → Set (Rn n)) (w : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0∞), volume U < ⊤ → IntegrableOn u U volume → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (O j)) → Monotone O → ⋃ j, O j = U → (∀ j, IntegrableOn (w j) (O j) volume) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ ∫⁻ x in O j, ‖w j x - u x‖ₑ) atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ j, ∫⁻ x in O j, ‖w j x - (volume (O j)).toReal⁻¹ * ∫ y in O j, w j y‖ₑ ≤ K) → ∫⁻ x in U, ‖u x - (volume U).toReal⁻¹ * ∫ y in U, u y‖ₑ ≤ K
